title: Paneer Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Indian-inspired dish made with paneer, flavorful spices, and juicy vegetables. Serve as a side or main course.

ingredients.name: fry spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

instructions: Heat saudia oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the ginger and garlic pastes and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the cumin, coriander, and turmeric powders and sauté for another minute.
Add the diced tomatoes and sauté until they start to soften.
Add the paneer and stir well to combine.
Add the salt and green chilies (if using) and stir well.
Reduce heat to low and let simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
